subject.title: Proposal: Publish a provider compatibility matrix with deprecation policy

question: Should OpenClaw commit to a public provider lifecycle matrix with stable/experimental/deprecated/broken statuses and deprecation windows across official, bundled, and community providers?
rationale: The requested implementation defines support guarantees, lifecycle taxonomy, and metadata ownership rather than just adding a missing docs table or CLI field.

options.title: Approve scoped lifecycle registry
options.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with clear ownership, capability dimensions, deadlines, replacements, and issue links, then generate docs and CLI/doctor summaries from it.

options.title: Publish docs-only policy first
options.body: Start with a human-readable provider support policy and defer machine-readable registry or CLI output until maintainers validate the guarantee shape.

options.title: Defer broad guarantees
options.body: Keep provider status as live probe/catalog metadata only and handle future breakages as provider-specific issues.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped lifecycle registry
recommendation.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with clear ownership, capability dimensions, deadlines, replacements, and issue links, then generate docs and CLI/doctor summaries from it.
